identity.title: [v0.92.1][TAIL-06.14][security] Require SSH recovery for public Spot Runtime

deliverables: Public SSH preconditions, negative Terraform tests, updated example and recovery runbook, sanitized live/disposal evidence.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Public null or blank key is rejected before apply.
AC-2: Public empty SSH CIDRs are rejected before apply.
AC-3: One existing approved key and explicit /32 SSH documented and proved.
AC-4: Runtime application ingress, IMDSv2 and encrypted EBS preserved.
AC-5: Separate private-only deployment is unchanged.
AC-6: Authorized bounded AWS reachability/isolation proof and disposal evidence retained.
dependencies: #520 security finding; operator key selection and bounded cloud approval for live proof.
non_goals: Changes to separate private-only deployment roots
Unrelated network redesign or unapproved cloud apply
